solutions.title: DFS cycle states
solutions.strategy: Mark each course as unvisited, visiting, or done while searching for a back-edge.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each course and prerequisite edge is visited at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The graph plus DFS recursion/state arrays are stored.

solutions.title: Kahn topological count
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly remove courses with zero remaining prerequisites and verify every course is removed.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each course enters the queue once and each edge lowers one indegree.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The adjacency list, indegrees, and queue are stored.
